samples.title: Giờ làm linh hoạt

samples.summaryVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for your email. You asked about a flexible working discussion, so I am happy to share the details. I thought of you when I saw the programme because you enjoy learning useful things with other people.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cảm ơn, nhắc đúng câu hỏi của bạn.

paragraphs.label: Hoạt động
paragraphs.text: We will compare working schedules and plan shared team hours. The aim is to connect the topic with everyday life rather than only listen to a long talk. One useful point is that employees can organise work around practical personal needs. For example, a parent can start earlier on two days so that they can collect a child from school.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Sắp xếp và gợi ý
paragraphs.text: The session is at the community centre on Saturday at nine in the morning. Please bring a sample weekly schedule and arrive about ten minutes early. If you want to prepare, think of one question about flexible working hours. We can compare our notes afterwards and decide which ideas would be useful in our own lives.

paragraphs.label: Kết thư

Best wishes,
Minh
